roles.name: Management
roles.blurb: Runs the park day to day. Keeps morale up and makes bad events less likely. You need one once you have more than 5 staff.

roles.name: Veterinary
roles.blurb: Keeps dinosaurs healthy. Cuts the chance of illness in half and helps sick dinos recover.

roles.name: Maintenance
roles.blurb: Fixes fences and keeps the park clean, which visitors love. Plan on about one per 3 enclosures.

roles.name: Security
roles.blurb: Watches the fences. Halves the chance of an escape and makes one less costly if it happens.

roles.name: Concessions
roles.blurb: Staffs the food stand and gift shop. Without them those buildings earn nothing. Up to 2 per store.

roles.name: Tour Guide
roles.blurb: Shows visitors around and tells dino facts. Happier visitors put up with a higher ticket price. Plan on about one per 3 dinosaurs.

morale._notes: M2.6: morale bleed halved (no-manager penalty 5 -> 2.5/month, late-pay penalty 15 -> 8/month). M3: over_capacity_penalty_per_month applies when the headcount is above the Park Office's management_capacity (facilities.json): a bigger office runs a bigger crew.
